evidence_warning: Evidence is severely degraded rather than genuinely empty: only 2 of 25 full-text fetches succeeded and both are off-core to the VLA manipulation question; the arXiv path failed with SSL errors, the anchor top-up also failed, and six load-bearing host nominations remain unresolved and were not admitted. All method residues below are therefore abstract-level hypotheses unless explicitly marked parametric awareness-only, and non-retrieval is not used as novelty evidence.

intake.domain: Non-tactile post-training of continuous-action diffusion/flow Vision-Language-Action policies under functional-geometry counterfactuals
data: simulator-grounded paired scenes made by minimal functional-geometry edits
successful action chunks whose validity flips under the paired geometry while language and task semantics remain fixed
clearance and contact traces sufficient to identify the earliest physically invalid segment
multiple geometry-specific alternative-positive action modes retained as positives
intake.expertise: embodied-AI simulation, diffusion-policy/VLA post-training, and physical-feasibility evaluation
intake.baseline: pi0.5 or another continuous-action diffusion/flow VLA, compared with ordinary imitation post-training, global physical-feasibility supervision, action-manifold learning, and inference-time multi-sample selection
intake.limitation: No tactile sensing; intervention and supervision must be visual/proprioceptive and simulator-grounded, should affect only the first clearance/contact-violation segment while preserving alternative feasible modes, and experiments may begin only after an independent novelty assessment exceeds 7/10. Literature coverage is severely degraded, so that novelty threshold cannot be inferred from retrieval absence.

bottleneck_statement: For conditional generative robot policies, a minimal geometry edit can leave the observation, instruction, and most of a previously successful action chunk semantically appropriate while changing physical validity only at a later clearance or contact boundary; trajectory-level imitation or feasibility signals then cannot distinguish a globally bad chunk from a geometry-conditionally bad suffix, so their update can corrupt the still-valid prefix or suppress other feasible modes. The available abstract evidence shows global geometry-aware representations and canonicalized action experts (dblp:journals/corr/abs-2606-08530), a simple geometry-grounded feasibility objective for a diffusion VLA (semanticscholar:dd324415c99589f1f7f9b63eaa3a64a7ae042df2), valid-action-manifold prediction (semanticscholar:8cb14cd9dafae88163a7685336a02ac6c41ed646), and largest-cluster action selection (semanticscholar:4a71dc5d2b6b4ea2a6477ec4515d8294e3c75383), but it does not establish a learning signal that attributes the validity flip to its first causal geometry boundary while preserving the conditional distribution's alternative positive modes. This is a structural credit-assignment and mode-preservation failure, not evidence that counterfactual local score repulsion itself is novel; the latter remains unverified because the most load-bearing full texts and six host nominations were unavailable.

closest_adjacent.summary_and_residue: The abstract adds a geometry-grounded physical-feasibility objective to diffusion-based VLA training and reports improved obstacle-aware reliability. It does not reveal whether supervision is localized to the first geometry-caused violation or whether alternative feasible action modes survive the update. [residue is abstract-level: anchor fulltext unfetchable]

The abstract predicts actions on a learned valid action manifold using multi-view latent geometry. Its residue is whether that manifold remains correctly multi-modal when a minimal functional-geometry edit invalidates one previously successful chunk but leaves several alternatives valid; this is abstract-level because full text failed.

The abstract samples several diffusion/flow action chunks and executes the medoid of the largest continuous-action cluster at inference time. It can discard valid minority modes and does not post-train the score field from paired geometry validity flips; this residue is abstract-level because full text failed.

The abstract combines coarse-to-fine action learning, semantic-aligned 3D integration, and embodiment canonicalization around a DiT continuous-action expert. Representation-level geometry alignment does not specify how to assign a counterfactual invalidity signal to only the first violating segment of an otherwise successful chunk; this residue is abstract-level because full text failed.

The abstract jointly denoises future spatial-temporal latents and actions and modulates action attention with predicted depth and end-effector geometry. It couples prediction to control but does not establish boundary-local post-training from same-chunk valid/invalid geometry pairs or preservation of alternative positive modes; this residue is abstract-level because full text failed.

what_phase_0_did_not_address: Within the severely degraded evidence, no retrieved frontier leaf establishes whether a chunk that is successful in one scene but fails after a minimal functional-geometry edit should be treated as globally incorrect or only conditionally invalid beyond the first changed clearance/contact boundary; the available feasibility and geometry-aware methods leave that attribution unresolved (semanticscholar:dd324415c99589f1f7f9b63eaa3a64a7ae042df2; dblp:journals/corr/abs-2606-08530) — stakes: practitioners can over-correct valid motion prefixes and waste scarce positive demonstrations, while the field can mistake generic feasibility regularization for learned functional-geometry discrimination.

No retrieved frontier leaf demonstrates segment-level causal credit for the first clearance or contact violation when earlier actions in the same diffusion chunk remain valid, rather than assigning one whole-chunk loss or selection outcome (semanticscholar:f134eaaeb2cf6d4ac3526993199033b7f858a35b; semanticscholar:4a71dc5d2b6b4ea2a6477ec4515d8294e3c75383) — stakes: post-training can distort temporally correct behavior, increase sample complexity, and leave researchers unable to tell whether gains come from boundary learning or broad trajectory suppression.

No retrieved frontier leaf shows that rejecting a geometry-invalid action mode can coexist with preserving all geometry-specific alternative-positive modes, especially feasible minority modes outside the dominant action cluster or nominal manifold (semanticscholar:8cb14cd9dafae88163a7685336a02ac6c41ed646; semanticscholar:4a71dc5d2b6b4ea2a6477ec4515d8294e3c75383) — stakes: a robot may become safer on one edited object while losing legitimate grasps, approaches, or reorientation strategies elsewhere, and apparent reliability gains may actually be mode collapse.

The retrieved leaves inherit whole-chunk conditional density fitting, global auxiliary feasibility, or outcome-level selection from the imitation/diffusion lineage, but none tests whether geometry-conditioned feasibility learning must score the complete action chunk as one unit rather than admit different validity along its temporal support — stakes: deployment teams lack a principled granularity for corrective data, and published post-training conclusions may depend on an unexamined supervision unit that does not transfer to delayed contact failures.

method_lineage.line: Physical-feasibility shaping of conditional diffusion/flow action distributions for VLA manipulation

nodes.method: Behavior cloning with pointwise or sequence action regression
nodes.move: Learn a policy by increasing likelihood or reducing regression error on demonstrated actions conditioned on observations and task context.
nodes.residual_problem: Averaged or unimodal action prediction poorly represents multi-modal valid behavior and treats demonstrated labels as globally valid for their observed contexts.

nodes.move: Replace direct prediction with iterative denoising that estimates a conditional score field over a multi-modal data distribution.
nodes.residual_problem: Density fitting preserves observed multimodality but does not itself encode task-specific hard physical feasibility under counterfactual conditions.

nodes.method: Diffusion Policy for receding-horizon action chunks
nodes.move: Condition diffusion denoising on robot observations and generate temporally coherent continuous action sequences for imitation control.
nodes.residual_problem: Chunk-level imitation leaves geometry-dependent clearance and contact constraints implicit and supplies no causal location for a delayed violation.

nodes.method: VLA with diffusion/flow continuous-action expert, including the pi0 family
nodes.move: Attach a generative continuous-action head to language-conditioned visual representations and scale it with diverse robot data.
nodes.residual_problem: Broad semantic conditioning and data scale do not identify where functional geometry flips a chunk from feasible to infeasible or how to correct it without erasing alternatives.

nodes.method: Explicit physical-feasibility supervision for diffusion VLA
nodes.move: Add a geometry-grounded feasibility objective during training and probe obstacle-aware manipulation.
nodes.residual_problem: The abstract does not establish boundary-local credit or alternative-mode preservation under minimal geometry validity flips.

nodes.method: Action Manifold Learning with multi-view latent geometry
nodes.move: Predict actions directly on a learned valid-action manifold while adding geometry-guided multi-view features.
nodes.residual_problem: Coverage of multiple valid modes under newly edited functional constraints remains unclear at abstract level.

nodes.move: Sample parallel action chunks, cluster them in continuous action space, and execute the largest-cluster medoid at inference.
nodes.residual_problem: Dominant-cluster selection can omit valid minority modes and provides no local post-training credit for a geometry-induced violation.

nodes.move: Combine coarse-to-fine action learning, aligned 3D features, a DiT expert, and embodiment canonicalization.
nodes.residual_problem: Global representation alignment does not identify the first action segment whose physical validity changes under a minimal geometry edit.

nodes.move: Jointly denoise future spatial-temporal latents and actions and modulate action attention with predicted depth and end-effector geometry.
nodes.residual_problem: Prediction-action coupling does not establish counterfactual boundary attribution or selective preservation of alternative feasible modes.

nodes.move: Use embodiment forcing and morphological tree diffusion to share action generation across related embodiments.
nodes.residual_problem: Cross-embodiment multimodality does not identify functional-geometry-specific invalid segments within one embodiment's chunk.

nodes.move: Generate hand/object poses and explicit contact states as a flow-matched interaction representation before robot retargeting.
nodes.residual_problem: Explicit contact representation still requires retargeting and does not supply local post-training credit to an ordinary VLA action score.

nodes.move: Estimate success-critical latent subspaces from success/failure rollouts and steer policy activations at inference.
nodes.residual_problem: Task-level success subspaces are rollout-dependent and do not isolate geometry-local violation credit or guarantee preservation of positive modes.

nodes.method: CHOMP/STOMP-style trajectory optimization with collision costs
nodes.move: Use signed-distance or sampled collision penalties to deform complete trajectories away from obstacles.
nodes.residual_problem: It supplies geometric avoidance but is a planner-level trajectory optimizer, not distribution-preserving VLA post-training.

nodes.method: Control-barrier-function safety filters and action shielding
nodes.move: Project or override proposed controls online to maintain a certified safe set.
nodes.residual_problem: Online correction can guarantee local safety under stated models but does not teach the generative policy's conditional action distribution.

nodes.move: Add a condition or classifier gradient to the diffusion score during sampling to shift probability toward desired outcomes.
nodes.residual_problem: Generic guidance does not determine temporally localized physical credit or protect multiple positive robot-action modes.

nodes.method: Energy-based contrastive learning with negative samples
nodes.move: Lower energy on positive data and raise it on negatives to shape a conditional density or decision boundary.
nodes.residual_problem: Unstructured negatives can repel valid neighbors, and the classical move alone does not solve geometry-paired temporal localization.

nodes.method: DAgger-style corrective imitation and recovery data aggregation
nodes.move: Collect states induced by the learned policy and add expert corrections to repair compounding errors.
nodes.residual_problem: Correction data addresses visited failures but does not by itself isolate minimal geometry-caused invalidity or retain alternative positive modes.

method_lineage.notes: Retrieved leaves are grounded only to supplied records and, for every load-bearing VLA paper, to abstracts because method fetches failed. Parametric ancestry and collateral nodes are awareness-only: they prevent regression to generic collision-cost trajectory optimization, safety projection, classifier guidance, contrastive negative learning, or corrective data aggregation, but they are not cited as prior art or used to assert novelty. The 2-4y Diffusion Policy node is medium-confidence because it sits just outside retrieval; the six unresolved host nominations, including counterfactual VLA and robot-data-augmentation candidates, are explicit coverage holes that must be manually resolved before accepting any novelty score above 7/10.

domain_pattern_distribution.notes: Among the 18 strict VLA/manipulation records, structural-prior encoding and heterogeneous decomposition are tied as most used (9/18 each), yet their abstract-level stopping points remain global geometry representation, component specialization, or task decomposition rather than localized counterfactual validity credit.
